units.source_text: 我对夫人抱有反感，同时对她的女儿的思念有增无减，因此，我们三人之间的关系比起我刚搬来时渐渐变得复杂起来。

en.t: I felt antipathy toward the lady, while my longing for her daughter only kept growing stronger; as a result, the relationship among the three of us gradually became more complicated than it had been when I first moved in.

units.source_text: 当然，这变化只限于我的内心，并没有表露在外。

en.t: Of course, this change was confined to my inner feelings and did not show itself outwardly.

units.source_text: 不久，一个偶然的机会，使我发觉以前恐怕是误会了夫人。

en.t: Before long, a chance occurrence made me realize that I had probably misunderstood the lady all along.

units.source_text: 我发觉夫人对我矛盾的态度都不是虚假的，

en.t: I came to see that neither of the lady's contradictory attitudes toward me was false,

units.source_text: 而且两种态度并非交替占据着夫人的心，而是一直并存于夫人的心里。

en.t: and that these two attitudes did not take turns occupying her heart, but had always existed there side by side.

units.source_text: 也就是说，我觉察到，夫人一方面想要让女儿尽量接近我，

en.t: In other words, I realized that, on the one hand, the lady wanted to bring her daughter as close to me as possible,

units.source_text: 一方面对我加强戒备，看起来似乎很矛盾，

en.t: while on the other hand she grew more guarded toward me, which seemed contradictory,

units.source_text: 但在加强戒备的同时，夫人并没有忘记或推翻相反的那个态度，依然想让我们接近。

en.t: yet even as she strengthened that guard, she had not forgotten or overturned the opposite attitude, and still wanted us to become close.

units.source_text: 我觉得，夫人只是不想让我和小姐接触的程度超出她认可的范围。

en.t: I thought the lady simply did not want Miss and me to have contact beyond the limits she considered acceptable.

units.source_text: 那时，我并未出于肉欲接近小姐，所以觉得夫人的担忧纯粹是多余的。

en.t: At that time, I was not approaching Miss out of physical desire, so I thought the lady's anxiety was entirely unnecessary.

units.source_text: 不过，我对夫人的厌恶感很快就消失了。

en.t: However, my dislike of the lady soon disappeared.
